summary: Frontend E2E testing of IT Asset & Infrastructure Management module completed successfully. All 7 requested flows passed end-to-end: admin sidebar entry & tabs, asset create (LAP-0001 auto-id, unique QA-SN serial), assign to employee with timeline updating (Created + Assigned entries), CSV template download, CSV preview (Total 2 / Valid 1 / Errors 1) and confirm import, CSV export download, employee self-view page (/employee/it-assets) loads, no admin menu visible for employee, direct nav to /it-management by employee is blocked (redirected to /employee/dashboard). Regression: admin Dashboard and Employees pages still load without errors after the new module was added.

issues: Radix DialogContent Warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby (accessibility warning in console). Add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: (Low-priority a11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to it-asset-form, it-asset-detail, it-action-dialog to silence Radix console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: ITManagement.js is ~440 lines with 6 components in one file — acceptable but consider splitting AssetForm/AssetDetail/AssetActionDialog/ImportTab into separate files for maintainability.
EmployeePicker calls /api/employees on every keystroke (debounced 300ms) — good; but no loading state indicator inside the picker.
AssetsTab exportCsv has no error handler; if request fails no toast is shown.
ImportTab uploads via {...authHeaders} without explicit Content-Type — axios auto-sets multipart, works correctly (verified).
AssetDetail useEffect deps disabled via eslint-disable — assetId is passed correctly, but should include authHeaders.
